original_test_intent: Verify every expected temperature sensor is present at the correct component/location and reports a plausible, condition-appropriate value and health OK.
original_method: Pin NVSM build; preserve diagnostics; load sensor identity/component/location/unit and warning/critical/range manifest; record ambient/inlet, workload and cooling state; run exact `nvsm show temperatures` read-only; retain raw values/status/health; check completeness, units, plausibility and condition-specific bands without changing cooling or workload.
manual_activity: Thermal/platform owner supplies sensor map and context-specific ranges and dispositions every missing, implausible, out-of-range or non-OK sensor.
required_inputs: Units, plausible bounds and normal/warning/critical ranges
safety_requirements: Never clear logs or alter fans, clocks, power or workload
Preserve missing, N/A, stuck, implausible and non-OK values
Do not judge without ambient/load context
